report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator's deployment hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order, and order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200 responses with zero 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is substantiated; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs for order and gateway (excluded from context) to confirm whether checkout errors occurred at all
Time-bounded error-rate metrics for /v1/checkout and /v1/orders covering the alert window
Deployment history showing any version change preceding the alert window
Trace samples with non-2xx status or error spans during the incident window
